weather_line: Crisp and dry in the hollows · tin lid rattles at 3 a.m. for reasons unexplained

stories.headline: Second Object Found Suspiciously Well-Placed; Analysts Upgrade Lucy Assessment From 'Concerning' to 'Architectural'
body: The Prophet's Household Situation Desk can confirm that the biscuit tin is no longer the only object of concern. At approximately 7:40 this morning, a previously wayward oven mitt — last reliably located draped over the pot rack in what analysts described as 'cheerful disorder' — was found folded, precisely halved, and resting squarely on the second shelf of the larder. The shelf it does not belong on. The shelf that is, crucially, adjacent to the biscuit tin.

No biscuit is missing. Analysts have noted this, quietly, and with less relief than one might expect. 'A missing biscuit is a crime,' said one senior observer, declining to be named. 'A perfectly placed oven mitt is a statement. We are not certain which is worse.' The tin itself remains centred. It has not moved. Neither has the distance between it and the mitt, which Pemwick — on secondment from the Duck Provenance Office and apparently at a loose end — has measured at exactly fourteen inches.

Lucy was observed this morning sitting beside the back door, looking out at the garden with an expression that household staff have classified as 'serene.' She has not looked at the tin once. This is the part that concerns them most.

stories.headline: Wednesday's Disputed Account Settles Itself Upon Realising Christine Has Arrived; Goblins File the Time as 'Precedent'
body: A mid-morning vault dispute — flagged Priority Amber and assigned three goblin adjudicators, a ledger cross-referencing team, and an emergency pot of tea — resolved itself at 9:53 a.m. when Christine entered the east corridor. Sources confirm the account-holder in question visibly reconsidered his position, sat back down, and asked for a glass of water. No argument was made. No counter-proposal was filed.

Vault Senior Quoyne has entered the resolution time into the Precedent Ledger under the subheading 'Presence, Diplomatic Effect Of.' He declined to comment further, which is to say he nodded, and has since returned to reading.

stories.headline: Appalachian Hollows Described as 'Still There, Still Waiting'; Jeep Described as 'Patient but Ready'; Steve Described as 'Thinking About It'
body: An informal assessment of the Red River Gorge circuit filed Wednesday morning notes that the fog has returned to the lower hollows in its customary September manner — low, thick, and apparently decorative — and that the ridgelines are displaying what one trail observer called 'peak readiness.' The rock arches are present. The mud is present. The Jeep is fuelled.

Steve has been observed consulting the trail map with the expression he reserves for serious mechanical decisions. The enchanted Jeep, which forgave him a minor gear-selection incident on Tuesday evening, has indicated no objection to an outing by way of idling very quietly in the drive and smelling faintly of petrichor. No departure has been announced. The hollows are not worried. They have been patient before.

stories.headline: Pemwick, Temporarily Without a Case, Volunteers to Measure Things; Ministry Declines; He Measures Them Anyway
body: With the Duck Bandit inquiry formally closed and commended, junior analyst Pemwick has made himself available to the broader Ministry. The Ministry has expressed appreciation and suggested he take a few days. Pemwick has taken this to mean 'begin an informal spatial audit of objects in proximity to the biscuit tin' and has cross-referenced his findings with the Duck Provenance Office case file, noting that fourteen inches is also, incidentally, the wingspan of the third duck's amber felt hat. He considers this 'probably a coincidence.' He has written it down.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Spent the morning in the garden. The garden had nothing to do with the oven mitt. She would like that noted.
Ellie: Discovered the oven mitt on the larder shelf and found it fascinating, then forgot what she had found, then found it again. Described the experience to Jersey as 'twice as good as once.'

Jersey: Has identified the warmest spot on the sofa following the slight seasonal rotation of afternoon light and has adjusted his position by eleven degrees. He considers this his contribution to the week.
founding_editor_note: Fourteen inches is a proper measurement. You need a tape, not a guess, and you need to write it down. Pemwick is doing fine. — D.

in_brief.sport: Wednesday Quidditch results withheld pending confirmation that the scoreboard is level; Don's portrait has offered to check.
in_brief.forecast: Crisp through Thursday · fog holds in the gorge · objects in the larder may continue to migrate southward · no cause for alarm, probably.

storyline_updates.title: The Biscuit Tin Endgame
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: A second object — the oven mitt, previously in cheerful disorder on the pot rack — has been found folded and precisely placed on the larder shelf adjacent to the biscuit tin, exactly fourteen inches away. No biscuit is missing. Lucy appears serene and has not looked at the tin. Pemwick, on secondment, has measured the gap and noted the coincidence with the amber duck's hat wingspan in writing. Household analysts have upgraded their assessment of Lucy from 'concerning' to 'architectural.' Day 3 should bring a decisive escalation: either a biscuit finally disappears with surgical precision and zero evidence (Lucy's masterwork), or a third object is found placed — something that reveals the configuration is not random but deliberate, perhaps forming a shape or pointing toward something, suggesting Lucy's campaign has a destination, not just a method. The household should begin to suspect they are not the investigators in this situation.
